summary: launchpad asks once, in Mission Control, before it sends any usage counts of its own.
notes: After your first app's questions, Mission Control asks once whether to send launchpad's own anonymous usage counts. Nothing is sent until you turn them on.
The window lists exactly what is sent and what never is, and you can change your answer any time at the bottom of the sidebar.
Not now asks once more a week later; Don't ask again means never. Claude no longer asks about it in chat.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
